caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue standing on a grayish wooden pedestal. The statue represents a human figure with brown skin and muscular build. The figure is wearing a garment resembling a fringed tunic or dress in a brownish-red color, adorned with large yellow and green feathers, particularly around the head as a headdress and belt, as well as across the right shoulder. The figure's left knee is bent and resting atop a gray stone, while the right leg is straight. The right arm is raised and bent at the elbow, holding a red and blue tomahawk, while the left arm is at the side, grasping a small brown pouch or object. The head is adorned with a large plume of yellow and green feathers, and the face bears a serious expression, with long dark hair flowing down the back. The statue and the base are depicted with careful shading, giving a three-dimensional appearance. The background of the drawing is plain and beige.
title: Cigar Store Indian
